final_draft.answer: Production databases are backed up daily. Backups are kept for 35 days and stored in a second region.
final_draft.note: I used the approved answer for control A1.2 word for word. It is valid until 2027-11-17 and owned by security@harborlight.example. It only covers production databases. If the customer is asking about other systems, such as file storage, configuration or endpoints, I found no approved source for those.

answer:ec46b748-4bff-49a3-a97a-cbf49b4f8: Production databases are backed up daily. Backups are kept for 35 days and stored in a second region.
answer:bc0ce2b5-be54-4745-990a-e0156f872: Infrastructure and container images are scanned weekly. Critical findings are fixed within 7 days and high findings within 30 days.
answer:2f3c8aec-5af0-4caf-a405-0ea3eddda: We test our disaster recovery plan annually. The last test was in March 2026 and met the recovery time objective of four hours.
policy:a3f1f08c-2c21-407e-bf59-830e103b6: Access is removed within 24 hours of a person's last working day.
answer:a2e32836-7edd-43c6-98fa-202108c02: Accounts of people who leave are disabled within 24 hours of their last day, through the identity provider.
